definitions.explanation: The immature form of an insect or other organism that undergoes metamorphosis before reaching its adult stage.

examples.japanese: ⟦カブトムシ→カブトムシ：05199_kabutomushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幼虫|ようちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。

examples.english: The larvae spend the winter underground.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{蝶|ちょう}→蝶：04288_chou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幼虫|ようちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{葉|は}っぱ→葉っぱ：05388_happa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦やがて→やがて：03637_yagate⟧⟦{蛹|さなぎ}→蛹：21225_sanagi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: This butterfly's caterpillar grows by eating leaves and eventually becomes a chrysalis.

notes:
USAGE:
{幼虫|ようちゅう} is the general scientific term for larval-stage insects. In everyday speech, people may also say ⟦{毛虫|けむし}→毛虫：04933_kemushi⟧ (hairy caterpillar) or ⟦{芋虫|いもむし}→芋虫：13965_imomushi⟧ (smooth caterpillar) for specific types.

LIFE STAGES:
The typical insect life cycle uses: ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧ (egg) → {幼虫|ようちゅう} (larva) → ⟦{蛹|さなぎ}→蛹：21225_sanagi⟧ (pupa/chrysalis) → ⟦{成虫|せいちゅう}→成虫：18745_seichuu⟧ (adult insect).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦カブトムシ→カブトムシ：05199_kabutomushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幼虫|ようちゅう} (beetle larva)
- ⟦{蚊|か}→蚊：04294_ka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幼虫|ようちゅう} (mosquito larva)
- {幼虫|ようちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{孵化|ふか}→孵化：19845_fuka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (a larva hatches)
- {幼虫|ようちゅう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{成虫|せいちゅう}→成虫：18745_seichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to grow from larva to adult)
